Serilog.//: Levels only. The console sink is attached in Program.cs, so a mistake here cannot leave the app with no logging.

Tenancy.//: The control database (tenants, plans, admins) and the tenant databases. Both are on the server of ConnectionStrings:PosMain unless ConnectionStrings:Control / ConnectionStrings:TenantServer say otherwise. AdoptDatabase registers a database built by apply-migrations as the first tenant. Database names are lower case.

Errors.//: true adds the exception message, type and stack trace to 500 responses, for local debugging only. Ignored in Production.
